title: Guess the bird in 3 clues

scenes.headline: 3 clues. Get it before the reveal.
Some of us wear a helmet on our bill.
To nest, mum is sealed inside a tree hole with mud.
Only a slit stays open. Dad passes food through it.
Hornbill!
scenes.body: Oriental pied hornbills in Khao Yai, Thailand. The bony 'helmet' is called a casque.

caption:
Answer's in the reel.

All hornbills except the two ground hornbills nest this way: the nest hole is walled up with mud, leaving a small opening for food deliveries.

Source: Britannica, Hornbill.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Question card, three escalating clue cards, then a footage reveal; no 'comment your answer' ask, the payoff is on screen.
